rules.title: Base rent freeze at October 1, 1985 levels with limited increases
rules.quote: All rents for rental of housing space and services in dwellings to which this act is applicable are hereby controlled at the base rent level received by the landlord as of October 1, 1985, and no rental increases shall be hereinafter demanded, paid or accepted, except as provided in this chapter.
rules.summary: Rents are controlled at the base rent level as of October 1, 1985, and no increases are allowed except as provided in the chapter.
rules.coverage_text: Dwellings to which this chapter is applicable
rules.penalty: Any rental increase in excess of that authorized by the provisions of this chapter shall be void.

rules.title: Annual rent increase limit: lesser of 5% or CPI
rules.quote: At the expiration of a lease or at the termination of a lease of a periodic tenant, no landlord may request or receive a percentage increase in rent which is greater than 5% or the percentage difference between the consumer price index three months prior to the expiration or termination of the lease and three months prior to the commencement of the lease term, whichever is less.
rules.summary: At lease expiration or termination, landlords may not increase rent by more than 5% or the CPI percentage difference for the lease term, whichever is less.
rules.coverage_text: Dwellings to which this chapter is applicable
rules.penalty: No more than one such cost-of-living rental increase in any one twelve-month period shall be permitted irrespective of the number of different tenants occupying said housing space during said twelve-month period.

rules.title: Tax surcharge allowed for municipal property tax increases
rules.quote: For any application for a tax surcharge after the effective date of this chapter, a landlord may seek a tax surcharge to be charged to a tenant because of an increase in municipal property taxes if said taxes are in excess of those assessed for the year that the landlord acquired the property or for the 1988 tax year, whichever assessment date is later.
rules.summary: Landlords may apply for a tax surcharge to pass through municipal property tax increases above the 1988 tax year or the year the property was acquired, whichever is later.
rules.key_value: Tax increase above 1988 or acquisition year
rules.coverage_text: Dwellings to which this chapter is applicable
rules.exemption_note: Tax surcharge not considered rent for purposes of computing cost-of-living rental increases. Rental units must be registered to qualify for a tax surcharge.

rules.title: Water and sewerage surcharge allowed for increases above 1996 levels
rules.quote: The landlord may seek a water and sewerage surcharge from a tenant because of an increase in the municipal water and sewer charges in excess of those assessed for 1996. The rental increase permitted for water and sewer surcharge is determined by the Rent Regulation Officer pursuant to a formula approved by the Rent Control Board.
rules.summary: Landlords may apply for a water and sewerage surcharge for municipal water and sewer charge increases above 1996 levels, determined by the Rent Regulation Officer using a Board-approved formula.
rules.coverage_text: Dwellings to which this chapter is applicable
rules.exemption_note: Surcharge not considered rent for purposes of computing cost-of-living rental increases.

rules.title: Capital improvement rental surcharge allowed with Board approval
rules.quote: Upon notice to its tenants, a landlord may apply to the Rent Leveling and Stabilization Board for a rental surcharge for capital improvement to the building and/or demised premises. Such application and supporting materials shall set forth the improvement, the cost thereof and its useful life.
rules.summary: Landlords may apply to the Rent Leveling and Stabilization Board for a rental surcharge for capital improvements, setting forth the improvement, cost, and useful life.
rules.key_value: Capital improvement cost prorated over useful life, max 33 1/3% increase per year
rules.coverage_text: Dwellings to which this chapter is applicable
rules.exemption_note: Building must be in compliance with housing maintenance, building, fire and other applicable City codes, and not subject to a City-held title lien. Base rents shall under no circumstances be increased by an amount greater than 33 1/3% due to a capital improvement surcharge in any one twelve-month period. Only 60% of cost allowed if improvement eliminates housing code violations enacted after January 1, 1985.
rules.penalty: No landlord shall impose upon any tenant a rent surcharge under this Article without first obtaining approval from the Board.

rules.title: Hardship rental increase allowed with Board approval
rules.quote: In the event that a landlord cannot meet his operating expenses or does not make a fair return on his investment, he may appeal to the Rent Leveling and Stabilization Board for a hardship rental increase. No landlord shall impose upon any tenant an increase in rent under this Article without first obtaining approval with the Board.
rules.summary: Landlords who cannot meet operating expenses or obtain a fair return on investment may appeal to the Rent Leveling and Stabilization Board for a hardship rental increase.
rules.coverage_text: Dwellings to which this chapter is applicable
rules.exemption_note: Board considers level of service, efficient management, prudent investment, and whether operating expenses are reasonably incurred. Not permitted when landlord has not made a reasonably prudent investment.
rules.penalty: No landlord shall impose upon any tenant an increase in rent under this Article without first obtaining approval with the Board.

rules.title: Two-year statute of limitations on excess rent refund claims
rules.quote: A refund and/or credit of excess rents shall be barred if the tenant's request for a legal rent calculation is not made within two years from service of the disclosure statement upon the tenant. The statute of limitations commences only upon proper service of the disclosure statement in compliance with § 155-4.
rules.summary: A tenant's claim for a refund or credit of excess rents is barred if they do not request a legal rent calculation within two years from when the landlord properly serves the required disclosure statement.
rules.coverage_text: Dwellings to which this chapter is applicable
rules.exemption_note: Nothing in this provision shall bar a tenant from requesting a legal rent calculation, nor prohibit the Rent Regulation Officer or Board from rendering a determination as to whether the rent of the dwelling is in excess of those permitted under this chapter.

rules.title: Two-year period of repose on rental overcharge collection
rules.quote: In no instance shall a tenant be allowed to collect rental overcharges for a period in excess of two years as determined by the Rent Regulation Officer or the Board.
rules.summary: Tenants may not collect rental overcharges for a period exceeding two years, as determined by the Rent Regulation Officer or the Board.
rules.coverage_text: Dwellings to which this chapter is applicable
rules.exemption_note: Nothing in this provision shall bar a tenant from requesting a legal rent calculation, nor prohibit the Rent Regulation Officer or Board from rendering a determination as to whether the rent of the dwelling is in excess of those permitted under this chapter.
